objects.name: schedules

objects.name: schedules_version

CREATE TRIGGER schedules_version AFTER UPDATE OF place_id,schedule_name,time_zone_id,occurrence_offset_seconds,schedule_time,move_time,is_changed,is_started,schedule_spare_time,schedule_note,lateness_time,done_status,started_at,finished_at,preparation_mode,preparation_template_id,preparation_template_name,preparation_template_deleted,preparation_frozen,score_contribution_recorded,recurring_segment_id,recurring_slot_key,recurring_ordinal,recurring_overrides,preparation_definition_id ON schedules
    WHEN NEW.place_id IS NOT OLD.place_id OR NEW.schedule_name IS NOT OLD.schedule_name OR NEW.time_zone_id IS NOT OLD.time_zone_id OR NEW.occurrence_offset_seconds IS NOT OLD.occurrence_offset_seconds OR NEW.schedule_time IS NOT OLD.schedule_time OR NEW.move_time IS NOT OLD.move_time OR NEW.is_changed IS NOT OLD.is_changed OR NEW.is_started IS NOT OLD.is_started OR NEW.schedule_spare_time IS NOT OLD.schedule_spare_time OR NEW.schedule_note IS NOT OLD.schedule_note OR NEW.lateness_time IS NOT OLD.lateness_time OR NEW.done_status IS NOT OLD.done_status OR NEW.started_at IS NOT OLD.started_at OR NEW.finished_at IS NOT OLD.finished_at OR NEW.preparation_mode IS NOT OLD.preparation_mode OR NEW.preparation_template_id IS NOT OLD.preparation_template_id OR NEW.preparation_template_name IS NOT OLD.preparation_template_name OR NEW.preparation_template_deleted IS NOT OLD.preparation_template_deleted OR NEW.preparation_frozen IS NOT OLD.preparation_frozen OR NEW.score_contribution_recorded IS NOT OLD.score_contribution_recorded OR NEW.recurring_segment_id IS NOT OLD.recurring_segment_id OR NEW.recurring_slot_key IS NOT OLD.recurring_slot_key OR NEW.recurring_ordinal IS NOT OLD.recurring_ordinal OR NEW.recurring_overrides IS NOT OLD.recurring_overrides OR NEW.preparation_definition_id IS NOT OLD.preparation_definition_id BEGIN
    UPDATE schedules SET aggregate_version = COALESCE(aggregate_version,0)+1 WHERE id = NEW.id;
    UPDATE recurring_schedule_segments SET aggregate_version = COALESCE(aggregate_version,0)+1 WHERE id = (SELECT root_segment_id FROM recurring_schedule_segments WHERE id = OLD.recurring_segment_id); END
